summary:
I've been building Keikochō, a Japanese-learning dashboard I use myself, with grammar drills, a story reader, and now manga pages built out of the same sentence data instead of baked images — a bubble is just a story sentence with a position, so the kana/furigana/kanji reading levels come for free instead of being three things I'd have to keep in sync by hand.

A chunk of the recent work is verification, not features. The text-to-speech engine has a check that reads back every generated clip and compares it to the reading I meant — it's caught real mistakes twice, including words that came out wrong because the tokenizer parsed a sentence differently than I intended. I've also learned to be suspicious of my own passing tests: I found one guard that was checking a rate against a shrinking population and had quietly stopped meaning anything, and another that read the wrong key from a JSON file and would have accepted "version" as a valid vocabulary word if the data had been there to trip it.

I put together a short farewell page (English and Japanese) for a job transition, published on my own site behind the same login as everything else so it opens on my phone with no second sign-in. The interesting failure there was two audio bugs stacked on each other: the page worked fine on desktop and was broken on my phone, and it turned out an audio-heavy static export doesn't travel well through a phone browser — one fix was serving real audio files instead of embedding them, the other was viewport handling that only showed up off a phone screen.

The common thread across all of it is treating "it looks right" and "it is right" as different claims. A layout bug can look like an intentional design choice if you don't read the language it's rendering; a passing test can be checking nothing at all if the thing it depends on changed shape underneath it. Most of what I've shipped lately is the tooling that catches that gap before a user does.

highlights.oneLiner: Published a bilingual farewell page behind the site's existing login, fixed phone audio/viewport bugs
